retrieval: Web Fetch 读取 arXiv 摘要页；PDF/HTML 细节只读到摘要能支持的范围
note: 来源编号与 research/FACTS.md 的「依据」列对应。论文以 arXiv 版本号、提交日期与摘要为准；没有读全文的条目只写摘要支持的内容。

wei-2022.title: Chain-of-Thought Prompting Elicits Reasoning in Large Language Models
wei-2022.author: Jason Wei, Xuezhi Wang, Dale Schuurmans, Maarten Bosma, Brian Ichter, Fei Xia, Ed Chi, Quoc Le, Denny Zhou
wei-2022.notes: 摘要：CoT 是「a series of intermediate reasoning steps」；在提示里给少量 CoT 示例；在三个大模型、算术/常识/符号推理任务上提升；540B 模型 + 8 个 CoT 示例在 GSM8K 上达到 SOTA，超过带 verifier 的微调 GPT-3。

kojima-2022.title: Large Language Models are Zero-Shot Reasoners
kojima-2022.author: Takeshi Kojima, Shixiang Shane Gu, Machel Reid, Yutaka Matsuo, Yusuke Iwasawa
kojima-2022.notes: Zero-shot-CoT：只加「Let's think step by step」；在 MultiArith、GSM8K、AQUA-RAT、SVAMP、Last Letter、Coin Flip、Date Understanding、Tracking Shuffled Objects 上评测；text-davinci-002 上 MultiArith 17.7%→78.7%，GSM8K 10.4%→40.7%。

wang-2022.title: Self-Consistency Improves Chain of Thought Reasoning in Language Models
wang-2022.author: Xuezhi Wang, Jason Wei, Dale Schuurmans, Quoc Le, Ed Chi, Sharan Narang, Aakanksha Chowdhery, Denny Zhou
wang-2022.notes: Self-consistency 替换朴素 greedy decoding：采样多条推理路径，边缘化路径后选最一致的答案；GSM8K +17.9%、SVAMP +11.0%、AQuA +12.2%、StrategyQA +6.4%、ARC-challenge +3.9%。

nye-2021.title: Show Your Work: Scratchpads for Intermediate Computation with Language Models
nye-2021.author: Maxwell Nye, Anders Johan Andreassen, Guy Gur-Ari, Henryk Michalewski, Jacob Austin, David Bieber, David Dohan, Aitor Lewkowycz, Maarten Bosma, David Luan, Charles Sutton, Augustus Odena
nye-2021.notes: Scratchpad：让模型把中间计算结果写出来（emit intermediate computation steps）；从长加法到执行任意程序，scratchpad 显著提升多步计算能力。

yao-react-2022.title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
yao-react-2022.author: Shunyu Yao, Jeffrey Zhao, Dian Yu, Nan Du, Izhak Shafran, Karthik Narasimhan, Yuan Cao
yao-react-2022.notes: ReAct 交替生成 reasoning traces 与 task-specific actions；reasoning 帮助计划/跟踪/更新行动，action 让模型接触外部知识库或环境；ALFWorld +34%、WebShop +10% 绝对成功率。

yao-tot-2023.title: Tree of Thoughts: Deliberate Problem Solving with Large Language Models
yao-tot-2023.author: Shunyu Yao, Dian Yu, Jeffrey Zhao, Izhak Shafran, Thomas L. Griffiths, Yuan Cao, Karthik Narasimhan
yao-tot-2023.notes: ToT 把 CoT 推广为在「thoughts」上探索：考虑多条推理路径、自评、前瞻与回溯；Game of 24 上 GPT-4 + CoT 4%，ToT 74%。

turpin-2023.title: Language Models Don't Always Say What They Think: Unfaithful Explanations in Chain-of-Thought Prompting
turpin-2023.author: Miles Turpin, Julian Michael, Ethan Perez, Samuel R. Bowman
turpin-2023.notes: CoT 解释会系统性歪曲预测的真实原因：在 few-shot prompt 里把答案偏置成 (A) 或加入社会偏见，模型会为错误答案编造看似合理的 CoT，且不提及偏置；13 个 BIG-Bench Hard 任务上准确率最多下降 36%。

snell-2024.title: Scaling LLM Test-Time Compute Optimally can be More Effective than Scaling Model Parameters
snell-2024.author: Charlie Snell, Jaehoon Lee, Kelvin Xu, Aviral Kumar
snell-2024.notes: 研究推理时计算扩展：搜索 + 过程奖励模型、按 prompt 自适应更新分布；compute-optimal 策略比 best-of-N 基线效率高 4 倍以上；在 FLOPs 匹配下，小模型在已有非平凡成功率的题上可用测试时计算超过 14 倍大的模型。

deepseek-r1-2025.title: DeepSeek-R1: Incentivizing Reasoning Capability in LLMs via Reinforcement Learning
deepseek-r1-2025.author: DeepSeek-AI
deepseek-r1-2025.notes: 用纯强化学习激励推理能力，不需要人工标注的推理轨迹；出现 self-reflection、verification、动态策略调整等模式；在数学、代码竞赛、STEM 等可验证任务上优于用人工演示做监督学习的对照。
